text:
jamal: FYI seeing SCIM provisioning failures for tenant=acmecorp right after we rolled the RBAC role rename this morning. errors show KMS decrypt failures. attaching logs.

alex: can you paste the exact error? guessing encryption context changed during the rename.

jamal: here is the stack snippet we got from the provisioner:```2026-03-23T09:11:02Z ERROR provisioner.scim: decrypt failed key=projects/redwood-kms/keys/identity context_mismatch tenant=acmecorp err=DecryptionFailure: encryption context mismatch (expected: role=engineer-old, got: role=engineer-new) trace_id=tx-8f7a```

mira: :eyes: that matches the hypothesis. We changed the RBAC role mapping in the identity service and the renames were applied without a rewrap. SCIM stores some attributes encrypted with KMS using role in the context.

petra: Confirming — our idp-sync job writes the attribute blob encrypted with KMS context {"role": <mapped_role>}. If the mapping changes, the decrypt attempts will fail unless we re-encrypt with the new context or accept fallback.

jamal: Any quick mitigation? A handful of user objects are stuck in deprovision/provision loops and Okta is retrying.

alex: short-term: add a fallback decryption attempt using the previous context values. I can push a small patch to the provisioner to try both contexts for 24h. longer-term: run a rewrap job to re-encrypt blobs under the new context.

mira: +1 on fallback patch. can we gate it behind a feature flag and log which tenant+user used fallback? want audit trail.

ops-bot: deploy request queued: patch/provisioner/fallback-decrypt to staging. CI passed.

petra: also need to think about audit logs — rewrap operations must be auditable and visible in the console. Otherwise compliance will flag silent KMS usage.

sre-oncall: Heads-up: if we enable fallback we will see a spike in KMS requests (double decrypt attempts) and extra re-encrypt traffic during rewrap. set budget alert and throttle if we hit QPS.

jamal: action items I captured: 1) alex -> push fallback-decrypt patch behind flag and include detailed logging (tenant, object_id, old_context, new_context). 2) petra -> plan rewrap job with audit events and a dry-run. 3) mira -> coordinate with customer support to notify affected tenants (small set) and pause automatic retries for the time being. 4) sre-oncall -> add temporary KMS usage alert.

alex: starting patch now. will post PR and link staging deploy.

petra: I'll draft rewrap plan: dry-run will pick 50 objects across 3 tenants, write audit events to audit-log-stream, and include a verification phase. target for run: today EOD if staging looks good.

mira: support note: sending heads-up to AcmeCorp CSM and flagging in support queue. template: explain root cause (role rename -> encryption context mismatch), temporary mitigation (fallback attempt & rewrap plan), ETA for fix.

jamal: sweet. tagging @idp-proxy-bot to dump last mapping table for acmecorp so we can enumerate affected objects.

idp-proxy-bot: mapping dump for tenant=acmecorp: `{old_role: "engineer-old", new_role: "engineer-new", last_change: "2026-03-23T08:58:12Z"}`

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood/provisioner/pull/492 (fallback-decrypt behind flag). staging deploy started.

ops-bot: deploy status: staging/patch/provisioner/fallback-decrypt -> SUCCESS (3 instances).

mira: can we enable the flag just for acmecorp first?

alex: enabling flag for tenant=acmecorp now.```/admin/flags set provisioner.fallback_decrypt.acmecorp=true```

jamal: quick check on staging logs shows ~12 items used fallback path, logged old_context values. looks good so far.

petra: proceeding with rewrap dry-run plan. will push audit events to audit-log-stream/rewrap.

sre-oncall: KMS alert tuned: threshold temporarily lowered to 1500 req/min and will page if exceeded.

mira: support note sent and CSM confirmed receipt. they want a short postmortem once done.

jamal: ok let's reconvene after dry-run completes. thanks all. :thumbsup:
